description.en: A-share trading-system assistant: market timing (bottom-exhaustion checklist + stabilization signals + suggested position by regime), sentiment & style detection (institutional-clustering vs speculative theme phases), sector monitoring with stage labels (initiating/fermenting/climax/retreat) and leader candidates, position sizing checks (total/single-stock/industry caps), trailing/ladder stop-loss alerts with time-stop, full-market screener (4 strategies), real-time tickers via pytdx, K-line charts, and 8 stock_* AI tools. Auto-starts a Python backend. Read-only — no auto-trading, no broker access.
description.zh: A 股交易体系助手：大盘择时（跌无可跌多因子清单 + 企稳信号确认 + 阶段判定与建议仓位）、情绪与风格识别（机构抱团期 vs 题材妖股期判定）、板块监控（启动/发酵/高潮/退潮阶段标签）与龙头候选、仓位体检（总仓位/单票≤25%/同行业≤40%）、移动止损与阶梯止盈预警（含时间止损提醒）、全市场选股（4策略预热池）、pytdx 实时行情与 K线图、8 个 stock_* AI 对话工具。插件加载时自动启动 Python 后端。严格只读——不做自动交易、不接入券商账户。
